hook.name: BullionTaxHook
hook.description: Levies a fixed 4% ETH trade tax on buys (ETH→GLD, taken in beforeSwap) and sells (GLD→ETH, taken in afterSwap) via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta returns. Accumulated ETH is held in the contract until flushed to a staking sink. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output reverts. Certain addresses (e.g. a buyback contract) can be exempted from the tax by the owner.
